config.note: No stochastic steps exist in Buckets 1.1-1.6: positive-pool merge/conflict-resolution is deterministic threshold logic, CD-HIT's greedy clustering and GraphPart's slow-nn partitioning are both seed-free. Reproducibility here means 'same inputs -> byte-identical outputs', verified directly, not 'same seed -> same sample'.

known_limitations: 179 Multi-AOP positives contradicted by AnOxPePred's own assay call are excluded from both the positive pool and the external control, pending manual/supervisor review (label_conflicts_anox_vs_multiaop.csv).
553 of the frozen positives (pre-CD-HIT) are E2 'provisional' -- Multi-AOP-only, no per-record assay metadata -- pending supervisor review.
91 CD-HIT representatives (9.8%) were excluded by GraphPart to resolve cross-fold homology violations at the 40% identity threshold (graphpart_excluded_for_homology.csv).
Fold 4 remains evidence-tier-skewed (64% E1) relative to the other folds (44-52%) even after label stratification -- a residual, not a defect, documented for awareness in per-fold metric comparisons.
pending_supervisor_approvals: Conflict-resolution policy (assay evidence overrides Multi-AOP's label) -- 2026-10-14 decision log.
E2 provisional-tier default for Multi-AOP-only positives -- 2026-10-14 decision log.
